name: Terra Drone Corporation
summary: Terra Drone Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of industrial drone solutions in Japan, Belgium, the Netherlands, the Republic of Indonesia, and internationally. The company is involved in the development of unmanned aircraft system traffic management systems for enhancing the safety of drones and urban air mobility flights. The company also provides aerial solutions for spraying pesticides, fertilizers, and pest control products for agricultural plantations, as well as land survey and plant monitoring, mapping and analysis of soil conditions, and monitoring weather conditions and rainfall.
